Initial release of the pet drying box heat stress analysis skill.

- Analyzes pet drying box area videos to detect early signs of heat stress, monitoring open-mouth panting, tongue color, and body movement.
- Supports both local video uploads and network URLs; invokes server-side API for analysis.
- Outputs risk levels and provides suggestions for automatic cooling or stopping the drying process.
- Strictly enforces open-id acquisition for every analysis and historical report query.
- Automatically formats and displays historical reports in a structured Markdown table.
- Designed for use in pet drying boxes, grooming salons, and animal hospitals to enhance pet safety.
